annotation.title_clean: Directive 2001/104/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 7 December 2001 amending Council Directive 93/42/EEC concerning medical devices
annotation.title_en: Directive 2001/104/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 7 December 2001 amending Council Directive 93/42/EEC concerning medical devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities
annotation.summary_en: EU Directive 2001/104/EC amends the Medical Devices Directive 93/42/EEC so that only devices incorporating stable derivatives of human blood or plasma as an integral part fall within its scope. It sets transposition deadlines and transitional rules. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Article 1(5) of Directive 93/42/EEC on scope regarding blood-derived substances
Member States must transpose by 13 December 2001 and apply from 13 June 2002
Notified bodies must take account of prior test results for devices with blood or plasma derivatives
Five-year transitional period for placing on market, two further years for putting into service
